# Have you passed the VAT threshold?

> Free UK tool: paste your monthly sales to see if your rolling 12-month turnover has passed the £90,000 VAT threshold, the date you must tell HMRC, when registration starts, and whether the Flat Rate Scheme saves you money. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
